answer: Resist Sybils with an anchored heartbeat chain: each identity must emit a signed pulse every epoch, each pulse chained to the previous one and to a public beacon, anchored in the ledger. New identities start in the umber tier, untrusted, and rise only as their unbroken pulse chain ages. History cannot be faked, copied, or bought — every pulse is signed by that identity’s key — and one missed pulse resets age to zero. Each fake identity therefore costs the attacker one live endpoint maintained for the full aging period; ten Sybils mean ten parallel live chains, with no sharing, no shortcut.
